required_scope: Known app PID and a single spawn observation; optional TID narrows scope. Do not combine attempts.
verified_pattern: owner_verified view=(?:default|westlake\.sealed\.child) resident_view=westlake\.sealed\.child abort=0x[0-9a-fA-F]+ getter=0x[0-9a-fA-F]+ gnu=0x[0-9a-fA-F]+ inheritance=caller_owned
unavailable_patterns: unavailable missing resident namespace; no loading fallback; namespace continues
unavailable unmapped resident compat; no loading fallback; namespace continues
unavailable result=[1-9][0-9]*; no loading fallback; namespace continues

interpretation.QUERY_VERIFIED: Only the NOLOAD query and symbol-address check succeeded. This is not app relocation, inherited visibility, single-copy or UI proof.
interpretation.QUERY_UNAVAILABLE: Optional pre-bootstrap query failed. Record unavailable; do not fail the entire smoke from this alone and do not count compat as successful.
interpretation.INHERIT_UNAVAILABLE: The optional edge failed even if owner_verified preceded it. Not compat success; callback continues.
interpretation.MIXED_OR_MALFORMED: Scope or marker ambiguity: retain unknown, never promote to success.
interpretation.UNOBSERVED: Missing logs are unknown, neither success nor failure.
interpretation.SKIPPED_DECLARED_BRANCH: Private or no-bridge branch was explicitly supplied and has no marker. Declaration is not dynamic branch proof; do not count success.

smoke_integration.coordinator_action: Do not inherit the U10.1 mandatory owner_verified marker unchanged into a final N11h smoke. Read this diagnostic separately after identity/control/owner gates; no regex OR between verified and unavailable as a success marker. The current master n11h.json is a separate FILL_ window template, not executed here.
